v3_policy: These values describe historical debt, not acceptable V3 target values.
V3-native code must not consume these ceilings as permission to introduce debt.
When legacy UI is imported temporarily, relevant debt must be inventoried and ratcheted downward as canonical owners replace it.
A migration slice is incomplete if it leaves a new parallel owner or unexplained style island.
Any exception that increases a measured legacy debt dimension requires an explicit reviewed V3 decision.
